outcome: serum laboratory values (platelet counts, aspartate aminotransferase levels)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 18 postpartum women diagnosed with class 1 HELLP syndrome at the Shiga University of Medical Science.
finding: High-dose dexamethasone significantly improved the recovery of platelet counts and aspartate aminotransferase levels, and did not increase maternal postpartum complications in postpartum women with class 1 HELLP syndrome.
